🚨 @Jeezy  weighs in on the current state of conflict resolution in hip-hop, explaining how some artists have lost sight of the music and are creating violence instead of art. The Snowman ⛄️ makes it clear that the violence referenced in his music was rooted in retaliation and not starting the conflict. Tap in on @netflix

Video

🚨 @jeezy pulled up to promote his upcoming Las Vegas residency, and we took a deep dive into the life of the Snowman ⛄️. From surviving the streets to embracing healing and personal growth, Jeezy opens up about this new chapter in his life and what healing means to him today. Tap in for the full conversation on @netflix ! 🎙️

Video

🗣️ @Jeezy will be live on The Breakfast Club discussing his upcoming 'The Legend of the Snowman' Las Vegas residency and more! Listen live on The Breakfast Club tomorrow! ➡️ breakfastclubonline.com/list…

Video

🚨 @marlonwayans breaks down why Shawn isn’t the Wayans brother to play with! Marlon explains what happened between Shawn and Aries Spears during their interview and why he didn’t come to The Breakfast Club to promote 'Scary Movie'. 👀🎙️🔥

Video

🫏 Donkey of the Day goes to 64-year-old Rick Chow of North Carolina, who was found "not guilty" after the fatal shooting 🔫 of a 14-year-old boy. Tap in as @cthagod breaks it down in #DOTD, powered by @msllegal 🐂 #MichaelTheBull #TheBullNYC.

Video

🚨 Daphne Joy speaks out after the release of an alleged leaked sex tape involving her, Diddy, and an escort. She has since taken to IG Live to answer questions all but one 👀 Tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa.

Video

🚨 An alleged leaked audio has surfaced of Sauce Walka has gone viral, in which he allegedly threatens Drake while talking to his baby mother during a heated argument. @lorenlorosa has the latest. 🔊

Video

🚨 The internet went crazy after Jay-Z hit the stage with a new fro, and people began speculating that his afro was a wig! Well, @luckylettty breaks down how, with the use of Cécred products, he was able to take down his locs and transition to a braid-out so quickly with his own hair. Tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa 👀💇🏾‍♂️🔥v

Video

🚨 Southwest Airlines has chnaged their way to support their 'Customers Of Size' as there is no addition charge to those passengers that need extra space on the plane. Some people are debating if this is fair, tao into Front Page News w/ @mimibrowntv

Video

🚨 @marlonwayans speaks on trying to get Dave Chappelle to be a part of @scarymovie and why they decided to reclaim the franchise and bring Scary Movie back for the culture 'Wayans Style'. Tap into the full conversation on @netflix right now 🔊🎬

Video

🚨 @marlonwayans stopped by to promote the upcoming @scarymovie film, out on 6/5, and we have Mr. Wayans to thank for this sequel 🥹. One of his final wishes was for his sons to come back together and create again. ❤️ Check out the full conversation on @netflix
